A '''grav lounger''' was a type of furniture that used [[Gravity/Legends|gravitational]] technology. [[Elbren BaChorin]] had a grav lounger in his office at [[BaChorin's Spaceways, Unlimited]] which was home to a pile of [[Star map/Legends|star-charts]].
